item.title: Targeted Treatment Improved Survival in Cholangiocarcinoma
item.description: Matched targeted treatment significantly improved overall survival in advanced cholangiocarcinoma in the Italian ANITA real-world dataset. The post Targeted Treatment Improved Survival in Cholangiocarcinoma appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Making Longitudinal Patient-Reported Outcomes Clinically Interpretable
item.description: New guidance details valuable approaches to analyze longitudinal patient-reported outcomes when many patients die during follow-up. The post Making Longitudinal Patient-Reported Outcomes Clinically Interpretable appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Metformin Reduces Long COVID Risk After Acute Infection
item.description: Two major trials show metformin taken during acute COVID-19 lowers long COVID risk, is safe, and could be added to outpatient treatment guidelines. The post Metformin Reduces Long COVID Risk After Acute Infection appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Can Meat Byproducts Be Harnessed to Benefit Gut Health?
item.description: Bioactive peptides from meat byproducts may help modulate gut microbiota while supporting more sustainable approaches to nutrition. The post Can Meat Byproducts Be Harnessed to Benefit Gut Health? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI System Improves MRI Breast Cancer Diagnosis
item.description: A new artificial intelligence system significantly improves MRI-based breast cancer diagnosis, reducing false-positive rates and inter-reader variability while enhancing risk stratification of BI-RADS 4 lesions. The post AI System Improves MRI Breast Cancer Diagnosis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: TBI Linked to Higher Dementia Mortality Risk
item.description: Long-term Framingham data show traumatic brain injury in older adults, often caused by falls, is linked to higher dementia-related mortality, with risk rising alongside injury severity. The post TBI Linked to Higher Dementia Mortality Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Photoprotection May Preserve Epigenetic Stability in Human Skin
item.description: Sunscreen use may prevent UV-induced gene and epigenetic changes, helping maintain pathways linked to healthy skin, according to new molecular profiling research. The post Photoprotection May Preserve Epigenetic Stability in Human Skin appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Scalable chikungunya vaccine breakthrough
item.description: Researchers at Griffith University’s are on the cusp of a significant breakthrough in the development of a vaccine for the chikungunya virus. The post Scalable chikungunya vaccine breakthrough appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: EAHAD 2026: Nine-Year Outcomes of Gene Therapy
item.description: Nine-year data show sustained safety and reduced bleeding after gene therapy in haemophilia B, although enrichment for full viral capsids did not deliver clear clinical advantages. The post EAHAD 2026: Nine-Year Outcomes of Gene Therapy appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Simple Fitness Test Predicts Pulmonary Hypertension Outcomes
item.description: Performance on the one-minute sit-to-stand test was a strong predictor of prognosis.
